metadata.case_name: CHIU YUEN YUEN v. BUCKINGHAM BANQUET LTD T/A BUCKINGHAM RESTAURANT

plaintiff.occupation_before: Housewife; part-time cashier assisting husband's taxi rental business
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: She should be able to resume her pre-accident occupation

source: X-ray showed that her right ankle was fractured.
the injuries to Madam Chiu’s right ankle were the direct result of the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

source: On 29 September 2015, she complained of lower back pain and was examined again at the Department of Physiotherapy of Princess Margaret Hospital.
Both doctors also did not ascribe Madam Chiu’s back pain to the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis, unspecified

manifestations.description: pain in her right ankle after walking and standing for 30 minutes or more
intermittent pain on exertion such as prolonged walking or standing
some loss of flexibility of her right ankle in relation to its range of movement
needed a stick to assist her for long journeys
required assistance for heavy household chores / was unable to do household work during prolonged treatment (10 months)
could no longer swim (previously enjoyed swimming with grandchildren)
lower back pain treated with physiotherapy and subjectively improved by 80%

treatments_received: use of two crutches on discharge
use of walking stick for long journeys

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Deprivation of household services to family during the period of incapacity (assessed as cost of hiring a Filipino maid for duration of sick leave).

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Could no longer swim with her grandchildren, which she enjoyed doing.
Residual loss of flexibility of right ankle and intermittent pain on exertion.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Right ankle fracture; hospitalised; cast applied; fracture united; some residual pain with stiffness of the ankle.
